title: RAID HUD TYPE IS COUCH SIZE
why: UI step 2 of the HUD hierarchy job (103). The critic said several fonts are too small to read from a couch and the contract line wraps. The belt key numbers were 14.8 px on the screen and are 16 now (the style guide floor). A contract line that would wrap in the run info panel takes a shorter wording when that fits on one line (haul over $1,200, carry 2x item, search 2 in place); the contract itself keeps its words. Step 1 (lower case) needs no change: no capital is drawn in a raid frame, the capital I the critic saw is the small i of the condensed face at 1080p. Watch: the belt key digits are a little bigger; a long contract reads shorter.
now: The belt key numbers are bigger. A long contract in the run info box is worded shorter so it stays on one line.

edits.replacement: ctx.font=hudFloor16(hudFS(TYPE.micro)); ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillStyle=HUDC.dim;   // v28.xx (cw-h103type): the north mark on the minimap is 16 px on the screen too
